rules: PRNG: mulberry32(seed), fresh for v2; every choice below draws from it in program order.
40 scenarios; each has a shared static prefix of 0-3 segments (a|b|c|x), so siblings sit at depth 1-4.

Each scenario has 3-6 sibling declarations: prefix + one sibling segment + a tail. The first sibling segment is static, the second a plain or constrained param; the rest are static (p=0.35), plain (p=0.25), constrained (p=0.25) or a final catch-all (p=0.15). Tails are 0-2 segments, static/plain/constrained, none after a catch-all.
Then 0-3 unrelated declarations made by the v1 declaration rule.
Methods and transports follow the v1 declaration rule.

Requests (12): p=0.5 instantiate a sibling; p=0.25 cross two siblings (prefix and sibling segment of one, tail of another) to force a partial match; else prefix + 0-3 pool values. v1 decoration and request methods apply.
Unsupported patterns are never produced: every generated pattern must pass compilePattern.
